title: LLM-driven multimodal target volume contouring in radiation oncology

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《LLM-driven multimodal target volume contouring in radiation oncology》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Target volume contouring for radiation therapy is considered significantly more challenging than the normal organ segmentation tasks as it necessitates the utilization of both image and text-based clinical information.
